description: This file contains helper functions and methods for managing provider authentication profiles, secrets, and OAuth credentials within the openclaw project. It includes functions for resolving secret references, building credentials, applying auth profile configurations, and writing OAuth credentials, with specific focus on provider-specific secret handling and profile management.

methods.name: buildEnvSecretRef
methods.description: Constructs a SecretRef object for environment variable-based secrets.

methods.name: parseEnvSecretRef
methods.description: Parses a string to determine if it is an environment variable secret reference.

methods.name: resolveProviderDefaultEnvSecretRef
methods.description: Resolves the default environment variable secret reference for a given provider.

methods.name: resolveApiKeySecretInput
methods.description: Resolves the secret input for API key credentials, handling references and normalization.

methods.name: buildApiKeyCredential
methods.description: Builds an API key credential object, either with a key string or a secret reference.

methods.name: applyAuthProfileConfig
methods.description: Applies authentication profile configuration to the main configuration object, managing profiles and provider order.

methods.name: safeRealpathSync
methods.description: Safely resolves the real path of a directory, returning null if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: resolveSiblingAgentDirs
methods.description: Resolves directories of sibling agents based on the primary agent directory.

methods.name: writeOAuthCredentials
methods.description: Writes OAuth credentials to the profile, optionally synchronizing sibling agent profiles.
